description: Audio post: denoise, voice clean-up, typed dynamics (compressor, limiter, gate), background music with auto-ducking, fades and stereo/mono handling.

argv.description: raw CLI arguments (non-canonical compatibility path; when present every other key is ignored)

audio_stream.description: which audio stream of the input to process, 0-based in file order (probe lists them under audio_streams)

bitrate.description: audio bitrate: AAC's beside a picture (default 192k), and the codec's of a lossy audio output (.m4a/.aac default 256k, .mp3 -q:a 0, .ogg -q:a 6, .opus 128k); refused for .wav/.flac/.aif/.aiff/.caf/.mka

channel.description: keep only channel N of the track (0-based, in the track's own order), as a 1-channel output (--stereo duplicates it to both sides); checked on the output by probe

comp_knee.description: knee width dB 0..18.06 (ffmpeg's linear 1..8; default 9.03, its 2.82843)

comp_threshold.description: dBFS above which gain is reduced, -60..0 (ffmpeg default -18.06, its linear 0.125)

denoise_strength.description: afftdn noise floor in dB below full scale, 20..60 (default 25; ffmpeg accepts nf -80..-20, and tn=1 then tracks the floor from this starting point)

downmix.description: downmix 5.1/7.1 to stereo with the ITU-R BS.775 weights (centre and surrounds -3 dB, LFE dropped), scaled so the fold-down cannot clip

dry_run.description: print the ffmpeg commands that would run, run nothing

duck.description: auto-duck the music by --duck-amount dB while the main track has speech (a sidechain gate keyed by it)

duck_amount.description: how many dB the music is lowered under speech, 0..60 (default 12)

duck_attack.description: ms the bed takes to duck once speech starts (default 20)

duck_release.description: ms the bed takes to come back up after speech (default 400)

duck_threshold.description: sidechain threshold in dBFS: the main track is heard as speech above this (default -26.02, the 0.05 linear used since 1.4)

effects.description: a third track (sound effects/atmos) mixed in at --effects-volume; never ducked

effects_volume.description: effects level in dB relative to full scale (default -14)

fade_out.description: seconds; fades the whole final mix (voice included)

fast.description: preview quality: x264 preset veryfast (overrides --preset) for quick iterations

gain.description: gain in dB applied to the main track, -96..96

gate_knee.description: knee width dB 0..18.06 (ffmpeg's linear 1..8; default 9.03, its 2.82843)

gate_range.description: attenuation when closed, dB -90..0 (default -24.26, ffmpeg's linear 0.06125)

gate_threshold.description: dBFS below which the gate closes, -60..0 (default -18.06, ffmpeg's linear 0.125)

json_brief.description: like --json but trimmed: status, output, dry_run, verified, a compact summary of the output probe, this tool's own keys, and the command count instead of the command lines (failures print the full failure document, unchanged)

length_samples.description: pad with silence or trim the output to exactly N samples per channel at the output rate (an audio output only: beside a picture the sound is conformed to the picture)

limit.description: look-ahead limiter (alimiter), level left as is

music_fade_out.description: seconds; fades only the music bed at the end, voice untouched

music_loop.description: loop the music if shorter than the video

music_volume.description: music level in dB relative to full scale (default -14)

mute.description: write the picture with no sound track at all (the picture is copied, not re-encoded); nothing else is done

on_silent.description: a --music/--replace/--effects file (or, under --duck, the voice) whose peak is at or below --silence-threshold: warn (default: mix it, report it under `silent`) or fail (refuse before ffmpeg runs)

overwrite.description: allow replacing an existing output (refused without it)

plan.description: write the dry run as a plan (inputs fingerprinted, commands, expected output, verify steps) that render.py FILE executes later; implies --dry-run

replace.description: replace the audio with this file (trimmed/padded to the video)

sample_rate.description: resample the output to HZ (aresample); checked on the output by probe. Default: the track's own rate

silence_threshold.description: peak level in dBFS at or below which a track counts as silent (default -50)

stereo.description: force 2-channel output (mono is duplicated to both sides)

stereo_widen.description: widen the stereo image, 0..1 (0 = untouched, 1 = maximum); needs a real stereo source: a mono input is refused (duplicating it leaves both channels identical, so there is nothing to widen) and more than two channels are refused unless --downmix folds them to stereo first

tempo.description: change the tempo of the main track keeping its pitch (atempo; 2 = twice as fast, half as long), 0.1..10; outside 0.5..2.0 it is a chain of atempo stages. Refused on the input's own sound while its picture is stream-copied (use fit.py --method speed)

timeout.description: kill an ffmpeg run past this many seconds, kind=timeout (default 1800; 0 = no limit)

track.description: add FILE's sound as one more audio track after the input's own (repeatable); -o .mov, .mkv or .mp4

track_lang.description: a track's ISO 639-2 language code (eng, jpn ...), in track order

track_name.description: a track's name, in track order (the input's own sound first); empty keeps the source's

voice.description: speech preset (default medium when the flag is given bare): light = highpass 80 Hz + gentle compression; medium = highpass, de-esser, denoise, gentle compression; strong = medium plus a harder de-esser, a second compressor and a soft limiter at -1 dBFS. MCP/JSON callers may still send the 1.12 boolean true, which is the bare flag and so means medium

name: audio
